selection: Retrospective piecewise-linear reconstruction between explicit project-authored numeric anchors; structural observations remain time-gated to their evidence years.
limitations: All numeric ratings are project estimates with low confidence, not source measurements.
2020 ITF activity status and 2026 association evidence provide structural context only.
No rankings, titles or athlete results are used to fit ratings.
2026 is partial through the bundle cutoff, not a forecast.
Linear interpolation is a transparent project-authored reconstruction between sparse numeric anchors, not a measured annual sporting trajectory.

construction.description: Annual project estimates are linearly interpolated between the existing explicit numeric calibration anchors and rounded to one decimal. Numeric anchors remain project-authored estimates; source observations stay time-gated to their actual evidence years, and future numeric anchors are used only for retrospective reconstruction.
